payout_value_note: flat amount in official terms

Submit the rebate application with the receipt and product details before the deadline (e.g., Glencoe: by November 30, 2026; within one year of purchase).
Receive the rebate check or bill credit — typically in 4-8 weeks (Glencoe: 6-8 weeks).
